subject: Fix last 3 SonarCloud issues
body:
Fix last 3 SonarCloud issues

- Remove unused searchTag and searchLink variables in InjectSriHashes
- Extract GetFileTypeChar from FormatPermissions to reduce cognitive
  complexity from 18 to below 15 (S3776)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

triage.rationale: Cleans SonarCloud smells in SSHTerminalBase/SftpFileService — fork-only xterm/SFTP features absent in our tree (verified); we use PuTTY for SSH and hold our own quality gate at A/A/A.
